The CLM reality at I&M

Your customers
live in both worlds.

86% digitally active means 14% are not — and even those who are digital still walk into 73 branches and speak to RMs. A CLM platform that only sees digital sees an incomplete customer.

Online-only CLM is not CLM.
It is half the picture.

WebEngage is equally good with online and offline. That is an architectural fact.

Platform Architecture

ZeroPII™

No personal data stored. Ever.

For a regulated financial institution, this is not a feature. It is the only architecture that should be acceptable. Your customers' PII never enters WebEngage's environment — not at ingestion, not during segmentation, not at delivery.

Three zeros.
Infinite intelligence.

Full CDP power. Without your PII ever leaving your environment.

Zero risk, full functionality
Segmentation, personalisation, analytics — all retained. No capability is traded for data sovereignty.
Zero development effort
Lightweight agent in your own cloud or on-premise. No re-platforming, no disruption.
Zero storage costs
WebEngage queries your data store — never copies it. You pay for engagement, not storage.
How ZeroPII works — architecture overview
01
Architectural guarantee — not contractual
PII physically cannot reach WebEngage Cloud because the architecture does not route it there.
02
Auto-masking for platform users
Marketing and analytics users cannot view raw PII. Role-based access controls govern visibility at every level.
03
Audit trails remain on-premise
Every data access event is logged within I&M's own infrastructure. Independent compliance visibility.
04
Kenya DPA 2019 and CBK alignment
Customer PII stays within Kenya's regulatory boundary. Cross-border transfer obligations avoided by design.
05
Composable — BYOL, Federated, Hybrid
ZeroPII holds across all three deployment configurations. The principle never wavers.
06
ISO 27001 · ISO 27701 · SOC 2 Type I & II
Current, audited certifications. Not aspirational — independently verified and live today.
